requirement.description: The View.__init__ method incorrectly validates that target objects must be data views, but it allows Signal objects to pass through without proper validation. This leads to TypeError when trying to construct Views with Signals that aren't data views.
requirement.contract: When constructing a View with a target parameter, the target must be a valid data view or a Signal that can be properly converted to a data view. The validation should correctly handle Signal objects and raise appropriate TypeError messages when they are not compatible with the layout.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method does not properly validate indexing operations for non-array layouts when the key is a Value or ValueCastable. It should raise a TypeError with a clear message when attempting to index non-array layouts with values.
requirement.contract: When accessing elements of a View with non-array layout using a Value or ValueCastable key, the method should raise a TypeError with the message "Only views with array layout, not {layout_type}, may be indexed with a value".

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method does not properly handle indexing with string keys for non-array layouts. It should raise a TypeError when attempting to index with string keys that are not valid field names.
requirement.contract: When accessing elements of a View with non-array layout using a string key that is not a valid field name, the method should raise a TypeError with a clear message indicating the field is invalid.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method has incorrect error handling for attribute access. It raises AttributeError with wrong message format for missing attributes and doesn't properly handle reserved field names.
requirement.contract: The View.__getattr__ method should raise AttributeError with appropriate messages when accessing non-existent attributes. For reserved field names, it should raise AttributeError with message format "View of {target} field '{name}' has a reserved name and may only be accessed by indexing".

requirement.description: The StructLayout.const method has incorrect handling for None values and improper error messages for invalid initializers. It should return a zero constant when init is None and properly validate the initializer types.
requirement.contract: The StructLayout.const method should return a zero constant when init is None, and should raise TypeError with proper message when init is not a mapping or sequence.
